# ODCS fixtures

Each `<version>/` folder is a snapshot of
[bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard](https://github.com/bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard)
`docs/examples/` at tag `v<version>` (Apache-2.0), with `apiVersion` rewritten to
`v<version>`. Upstream validates its examples against that tag's schema, but many still
declare an older `apiVersion`; contract-checker picks the schema from `apiVersion`, so it
is rewritten.

Do not edit these files by hand. They are generated by `scripts/update_schemas.py`
(automatically for new versions, or for all versions with
`--resnapshot-odcs-examples`) and are linted by
`tests/integration/test_odcs_upstream_examples.py`. Put hand-written ODCS contracts
for your own tests elsewhere, as a re-snapshot replaces the whole `<version>/` folder.
